messages.subject: Caspian Atlas — Schedules 1, 3 and 4
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Adam, Paul,

Further to the draft agreement, please find the Statement of Work (Schedule 1), the SLA (Schedule 3) and the Data Processing Agreement (Schedule 4). The SLA reflects a 99.5% availability target as our opening position. The DPA is on our standard processor terms.

Grateful for any comments alongside your mark-up of the main agreement.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0100 | whitfieldcarter.com
